theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl P) (K : ℝ≥0) (B : Set (Eucl m)), LipschitzWith K G → MeasurableSet B → InjOn G B → (∀ b ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ G b) → ∀ g : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → Measurable (fun s : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in G '' B, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∧ ∫⁻ y in {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ G '' B}, g y ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, ∫⁻ x in G '' B, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
